scope: LOCAL read-only source/contracts analysis for the unified project workspace request. No app edits, helper/remote/API/service/model/Git-network execution or application tests.
conclusion: Reuse the existing supervisor execution and policy loop. A unified UI is enough for most viewing/explicit existing-session actions, but not a reliable goal-only first kickoff: add one small durable idempotent kickoff coordinator over existing task-create/supervisor-create/start kernels plus read-only context resolution. Do not build a new automation platform or claim a cross-SQLite transaction.

minimalUserFlow.user: Select project; see its goal, current work, actual run/native session, block/next action and remaining independent acceptance.
minimalUserFlow.server: Read project, supervisor view, work console and actual bound task/run. Existing project has a supervisor: reuse this entity, no create/adopt/start on open.

minimalUserFlow.user: Describe target and choose a readable development server/workspace only if there is no unique valid existing choice. No taskID or native sessionID entry.
minimalUserFlow.server: Read-only context resolves project-owned managed tasks, registered nonproduction copies and configured project-supervisor executor. Unambiguous safe never-run draft can be explicitly reused; old paused/blocked/completed/history is not silently restarted or replaced.

minimalUserFlow.user: Explicitly start the described goal; show established scope and record-only cost policy with preserved unknown history.
minimalUserFlow.server: One fixed commandId/context binding goes through durable kickoff stages. It creates at most one needed never-run task and one supervisor draft, then calls original start/policy authorization only because start was explicitly requested. No hidden adopt or fake running.

minimalUserFlow.user: See Jarvis directive, actual CC response, decision and next step in one chronological view.
minimalUserFlow.server: Existing supervisor dispatch-intent -> execution request/outbox -> signed agent claim -> native invocation -> signed normal terminal/evidence -> strict model decision -> next bounded round. Native session is learned from real receipts and reused on next request, not synthesized or guessed.

minimalUserFlow.user: Supply requested information, send an explicit execution instruction, correct facts/preferences, or pause/stop from the same workspace.
minimalUserFlow.server: Read-only questions remain read-only. Existing reply is an execution command; use it only for explicit eligible next-turn instruction. Current live child has no general native stdin messaging API. Report queued or next-turn semantics honestly; do not say current CC received text without delivery proof.

minimalUserFlow.user: Review evidence and independent acceptance separately from Jarvis judged target met.
minimalUserFlow.server: Keep achieved/review/actual run outcome, human acceptance and actual package/deployment separate. Existing task accept records human attestation; existing package command records release metadata, not real ZIP creation or deployment.

existingAPI.use: Project/task resolution must page all records, filter owner/scope/project; never select latest arbitrary task or require manual IDs.
Resolve existing configured template and actual server/run. Ready metadata alone is not a dispatch or physical workspace proof. No re-pair or config write is needed in the main flow.
Real session/policy/stop proof/events; SSE reread never creates or resumes. Existing event history supports >100.
Factual work/events/acceptance projections; ledger is not dispatcher.

existingAPI.semantics: Only queued record; no execution receipt. sessionId optional in legacy contract but fresh kickoff must omit it. Runtime actual CLI session comes from trusted results.
Draft enabledfalse only; rejects any task executionRequest or native session with TAKEOVER_REQUIRED. One supervisor per project.

Explicit start/resume can authorizeContinuous with acknowledged unknown history and finite maxParentTokens. Pause/stop/takeover/revise revoke policy. Original CAS/version and stop proof gates must remain.

Not read-only: creates enabled running session that inspects/model-judges a currently saved trusted signed terminal. Requires exact task/run/resultH/owner/project/machine/workspace/native session/nonprod copy. Must be a distinct explicit action, never implicit open or kickoff.
May enable trusted terminal judgment; completed model intent reused, uncertain consumed model result blocks/requires owner resolution instead of blind replay.
Exact event/hash + typed fact/preference/applyTo preserved. current_followup revokes/pauses and stops current run before later reauthorization; future_reference does not change the active execution.

Existing owner-only one-round bounded continuation grant; unknown history requires explicit acknowledgment, is never cleared. Prefer original continuous goal policy windows for ordinary supervisor continuation, not a per-turn approval UI.

accept only validating state with actual declared artifact IDs/evidence; human_attestation. package requires completed/pass/artifacts and creates immutable release metadata, not actual packaging/deploy.

confirmedGapsForThisRequest.gap: Fresh first-use split across unrelated task form and supervisor form; manual taskID option and raw workspace required. No goal-only context resolver/kickoff route exists.

Generic chat is not a project command controller. /api/chat/conversations stores central chat session; project supervisor model uses random ephemeral bounded conversation with no tools. Factory/monitor tools exposed there are read-only. A central chat conversation is not the 101 native CLI session.

reply sets enabledtrue and dispatching or running; treating any composer text or status query as reply could restart paused work and does not prove delivery to live CC. At present blocked/judging/review branches have strict eligible actions.

adopt reports session running while source run is terminal; UI cannot use supervisor.status alone to say CC is currently executing. Main status must combine persisted supervisor phase and actual bound run status.

Task and supervisor/intents use separate SQLite stores. A frontend tasks.create then supervisor.create can leave an unbound queued task after interruption. Existing scheduleManaged may dispatch unowned queued tasks under old global/scoped supervision, so source ownership/reservation must close that interval.

Registered project copies are declarations; copies endpoint explicitly records filesystemAccessed:false. Context must not claim a physical remote workspace was created/verified from registration alone; agent checked workspace remains authoritative. Missing known safe copy should return concrete prerequisite, not fabricate a directory or session.

smallImplementationSlice.readOnlyResolution: Extend existing supervisor GET with a safe context/allowedActions projection, or a small sibling GET /supervisor/context. No mutation/model call. Return projectVersion, current session/task/run versions, actual native session if known, allowed registered nonprod copies, eligible existing configured templates, explicit ambiguity/missing reasons, candidate binding hash. Reuse existing session first. User sees names/paths, internal IDs stay hidden.
smallImplementationSlice.explicitKickoff: Add POST /supervisor/kickoff with fixed commandId, expected project/context binding, goal/criteria, selected machine/workspace/executor refs and explicit start choice. Current principal owns everything; body cannot supply another owner. Reuse existing task-create and supervisor-create/start validators as server kernels rather than loopback HTTP or duplicating execution logic.
smallImplementationSlice.idempotentStages: Small durable kickoff intent keyed by actor/project/commandId plus request fingerprint and fixed child command IDs. Prevalidate ownership/copy/template/purpose/record-only/executor readiness and existing history before writing. Resolve -> task created/reused -> supervisor draft created/reused -> explicit start accepted. Persist exact receipts/IDs. On retry same command and same binding returns/reconciles previous stage; changed body rejects. Unknown dispatch/start result blocks/reconciles; no new nonce, task or session to get green.
smallImplementationSlice.crossStoreOwnership: Do not claim one SQLite transaction. Pending kickoff reservation must be respected by supervisor ownership / normal scheduleManaged/start/preflight, including recovery from a committed task-create receipt before supervisor write. No queued orphan may run under unrelated old global supervision. No compensating deletion of task/history. A persisted incomplete stage is visible and repairable.
smallImplementationSlice.existingSessionRules: Existing supervisor wins; opening returns it. Only an explicitly selected safe never-run task with same project/scope/machine/executor/workspace, no session/executionRequest/history can be reused for initial create. Paused/blocked/history never auto-start, hidden adopt, invisible resume or replacement task. Explicit authorized continuation goes through original resume/reconcile/adopt rules with CAS and evidence. Native new_session only through existing signed stop/handoff proof.
smallImplementationSlice.composer: Keep simple visible text, but typed server action separates read-only status/question from execution instruction, requested-info reply, goal revision and pause/stop/resume. Server enforces eligibility; do not rely on labels or model prose as authority. Small first slice may keep read-only snapshot plus explicit Send instruction instead of introducing another free-form tool agent. If instruction submitted during active native invocation, either reject with truthful wait reason or persist an explicitly pending next-turn message with CAS and consumption; never promise live delivery without an implemented receipt.
smallImplementationSlice.authorizationAndCost: Explicit start reuses original owner policy and finite technical round/time/token windows, record-only money and known/unknown/incomplete accounting. No extra per-round manual approval. Existing task-create budget remains a legacy required field; reuse validated server defaults internally for record-only task compatibility, never invent an amount as actual cost or expose a new financial cap. Do not alter old global supervision or 10-minute automation.
smallImplementationSlice.noNewLifecycleEngine: Reuse original dispatch/outbox/claim/strict feedback/evidence/model decision/policy window/experience correction/notification loop. Keep independent acceptance and actual delivery separate. No new pairing, raw-session import, SSH controller, timer, autonomous platform or report-based fake completion.

meaningfulRegressionScenarios: Fresh project known safe copy/template, goal submitted once -> exactly1task+1draft+1authorized execution request; before start draft/not running, after queue still not claimed, only real claim shows running/native session later signed.
Same kickoff command body repeated, double click, response lost, restart after each stage -> exact original receipts/IDs, no extra task/run/session/model call; changed body/CAS conflict rejects.
Failure between task commit and supervisor binding while old global supervision enabled -> reserved task cannot be picked up by ordinary scheduler; history preserved and incomplete stage visible.

Existing supervisor or paused/blocked/history task -> opening and context reads produce0mutations,0model/CCcalls; explicit continue preserves same task/native session/workspace and unknown ledger, no old10min restart.

Status question in composer reads only; explicit instruction eligible waiting state may dispatch once. Running/judging/stop-pending instructions are truthfully rejected or pending with one consumption, never claimed delivered to current child.

Missing/ambiguous task or copy/template, wrong owner/company/production workspace, offline or unready executor, changed context/version -> concrete nonexecution blocker and retained input, no hidden fallback or guessed IDs.
Signed terminal -> normal Jarvis continue -> same native lineage; missing evidence/unknown usage/model uncertain remain blocked or incomplete, no0normalization as fact or auto-completion.

Stop requested vs signed stop confirmed, current-followup correction vs future-reference, supervisor achieved vs task human acceptance vs package/deployment metadata remain distinct in unified real component render.

Legacy project/task/supervision URLs resolve one workspace with correct drawer and back navigation; mixed known0/positive/unknown usage and >100history remain usable. UI IA details are separately reviewed by A.
